help.heading: Page guide
help.dashboard: Your farm at a glance: quick access cards, today's events and the weather. Use the cards to jump straight to your farms, harvests, the market or reports.
help.farm: The hub for everything you own. Open a section to manage land, livestock, plant stock, fruit trees, equipment or balances. Start by adding a farm — most other records are attached to one.
help.land: Your farmland. Add a farm with its name, location and area, then open it to manage its plots and crops.
help.landDetail: This farm's plots and what is planted on each. Add a plot with its crop and area, or click one to edit or delete it.
help.livestock: Groups of animals you keep, with a headcount for each. Production records what a group produces; Individual animals tracks each animal separately. The balance button shows production totals.
help.livestockBalance: Totals of your livestock production over a chosen period.
help.livestockDetail: Every animal in this group. Open an animal to see its history, medical records and individual production.
help.animalHistory: This animal's full history: medical records and production entries.
help.livestockProduction: Production records for this group — milk, eggs, wool and more. Add amounts by date; sold amounts are reflected in balances.
help.stock: Your vegetable and crop stock. Open an item to see its history and record new amounts.
help.stockHistory: Changes to this stock item over time, with photos.
help.fruits: Your fruit trees. Open an item to see its history and record new amounts.
help.fruitsHistory: Changes to this tree stock over time.
help.balance: Balances of your plant stock and livestock production in one place.
help.equipment: Machines and tools you own. Add equipment with a photo and quantity.
help.harvest: Planned and finished harvests. Create a harvest with an expected date and the items to gather; overdue harvests are highlighted. Open one to record the actual results.
help.harvestDetail: The plan and results of this harvest. While planning, add the items to gather; once harvested, record the actual amounts.
help.market: The marketplace. Browse listings from other farmers or create your own to sell produce or rent out equipment.
help.marketDetail: Listing details: photos, price, quantity and how to contact the seller.
help.report: Reports about your farm. Pick harvests, production or stock to see totals over a period.
help.reportHarvest: Totals of your harvests over a period.
help.reportProduction: Totals of your livestock production over a period.
help.reportStock: How your stock changed over a period.
help.calendar: Your farm calendar: tasks and expected harvests by day. Pick a day to add a task.
help.profile: Your account: photo, contact details, private info and subscription plan.

seo.title: Mtabari — Farm Management Software
seo.description: Mtabari — farm management software for Georgian growers: land, livestock, orchards, greenhouses, harvests and stock in one record. Keep the books, sell online.
seo.shareDescription: Run your whole farm from one place — land, livestock, orchards, greenhouses, harvests, stock and sales.

hero.title: Run your whole farm from one place
hero.subtitle: Mtabari keeps your land, livestock, orchards, greenhouses and harvests in a single record — from the first seed to the sale. Track stock, plan harvests, watch the numbers and sell your produce, on your phone or in the browser.
hero.note: No card needed · Free plan forever

packets.title: Pick the packet that fits your farm
packets.subtitle: Start on Free and move up when the holding outgrows it. Every packet keeps the same full record — what changes is how much of it you can hold.

manage.title: Everything you can manage
manage.subtitle: One record for the whole holding — the field, the barn, the orchard and the greenhouse.

stock.title: Stock Management
stock.body: Every kilo you hold, with the history behind it.
stock.point1: Vegetables, grain and produce by kind and unit
stock.point2: Every movement in and out, with photos
stock.point3: Seed stock sown against each harvest
stock.point4: Live balances you can list for sale

livestock.title: Livestock Management
livestock.body: Whole groups or single animals — your call.
livestock.point2: Individual animals with their own history
livestock.point4: Milk, eggs and wool production per group

fruits.title: Fruit Orchard Management
fruits.body: Trees are picked, not sown each season — so they get their own space.
fruits.point1: Trees by kind, block and planting date
fruits.point3: Fruit produce: juice, dried fruit, preserves
fruits.point4: Yield per tree and per hectare

greenhouse.title: Greenhouse Management
greenhouse.body: Covered growing, planned down to the square metre.
greenhouse.point1: Floors, beds and sections on a real layout
greenhouse.point2: Stock and seed placed where they actually grow
greenhouse.point4: Expenses and results per growing cycle

harvest.title: Harvest management, start to finish
harvest.subtitle: Plan it, pick it, store it — then see what it was worth.

record.title: Record harvests
record.body: Plan a harvest with its expected date and the items to gather, then record what actually came in. Overdue ones are flagged for you.

warehouse.title: Warehouse tracking
warehouse.body: A finished harvest lands in stock automatically, and every movement after it is kept — nothing leaves the store unrecorded.

quality.title: Quality grading
quality.body: Grade each result, compare planned against actual and read yield per area, cost per kilo and revenue per kilo.

history.title: Production history
history.body: Every season stays searchable, so this year's numbers always have last year's beside them.

market.title: Sell what you grow, find what you need
market.subtitle: A market between farmers, wired straight into your own stock.

buySell.title: Buy & Sell
buySell.body: List in seconds from stock you already hold — what sells comes straight off the balance.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.body: Sell or rent out tractors, trailers and tools by the day.

livestock.title: Livestock
livestock.body: Cattle, sheep and poultry, with photos and headcount.

produce.title: Produce
produce.body: Vegetables, fruit, milk and preserves, priced in your own units.

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.body: Trade seed and seedlings with growers close to you.

reports.title: Reporting & analytics
reports.subtitle: Filter by season, quarter or a range of your own — every report answers for the same period.

inventory.title: Inventory reports
inventory.body: What came in, what went out and what is left, per product.

harvest.title: Harvest reports
harvest.body: Yield, revenue, expenses and net, by harvest or by day.

financial.title: Financial reports
financial.body: Revenue set against fuel, workers and equipment costs.

livestock.title: Livestock performance
livestock.body: Milk, eggs and wool per group over any period.

greenhouse.title: Greenhouse analytics
greenhouse.body: Cycle results per section, with chemicals and expenses.

map.title: Your land, and everyone else's
map.subtitle: Mark your boundaries on satellite imagery and see the farms around you — whose land it is, how far off, and what is growing on it.

draw.title: Mark out your fields
draw.body: Trace a boundary on satellite imagery corner by corner and drag one to correct it — the area comes out of the shape itself.

nearby.title: See who farms around you
nearby.body: Every field marked within 10 km on one map, each under its owner's pin: your own land in green, neighbours in amber, everyone else in blue.

crops.title: Know what grows next door
crops.body: Pick a field to see whose it is, how far off, the rest of the land they hold and the crops on that particular patch.

connect.title: Add a neighbour on the spot
connect.body: Send a neighbour request from the field you are looking at — the map recolours the moment it is accepted.

mobile.title: Your farm in your pocket
mobile.subtitle: The same account and the same records — on the tractor, in the barn or at the market.

android.title: Android & iOS
android.body: A native app for both, built from the same codebase as the web app.

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.body: Record in the field with no signal; entries sync the moment you are back on.

sync.title: Cloud synchronization
sync.body: Every device sees the same numbers seconds after they change.

cta.title: Ready to modernize your farm?
cta.subtitle: Create your account, add your first field and record your first harvest today — it takes about five minutes.
